name: Divine Hymn
description:
Heals all party or raid members within 40 yards for 10,579 over 4.5 sec. Each heal increases all targets' healing taken by 4% for 15 sec, stacking.

You gain Guardian Spirit while channeling Divine Hymn.

Healing reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Guardian Spirit
description: Calls upon a guardian spirit to watch over the friendly target for 10 sec, increasing healing received by 60%. If the target would die, the Spirit sacrifices itself and restores the target to 40% health.\n\nCastable while stunned. Cannot save the target from massive damage.

name: Apotheosis
description: Reset the cooldown of your Holy Words, and enter a pure Holy form for 20 sec, increasing the cooldown reductions to your Holy Words by 200% and reducing their cost by 70%.

name: Mass Dispel
description: Dispels magic in a 15 yard radius, removing all harmful Magic from 5 friendly targets and 1 beneficial Magic effect from 5 enemy targets. Potent enough to remove Magic that is normally undispellable.

name: Power Infusion
description: Infuses the target with power for 15 sec, increasing haste by 20%.\n\nCan only be cast on players.

name: Desperate Prayer
description: Increases maximum health by 25% for 10 sec, and instantly heals you for that amount.

name: Halo
description: Creates a ring of Shadow energy around you that quickly expands to a 40 yd radius, healing allies for 610 and dealing 537 Shadow damage to enemies. Healing reduced beyond 6 targets.

name: Holy Word: Chastise
description: Chastises the target for 1,491 Holy damage and incapacitates them for 4 sec.

name: Psychic Scream
description: Lets out a psychic scream, causing all enemies within 8 yards to flee, disorienting them for 8 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect.

name: Fade
description: Fade out, removing all your threat and reducing enemies' detection range against you for 10 sec.

name: Holy Fire
description: Consumes the enemy in Holy flames that cause 1,173 Holy damage and an additional 421 Holy damage over 7 sec.

name: Leap of Faith
description: Pulls the spirit of a party or raid member, instantly moving them directly in front of you.

name: Angelic Feather
description: Places a feather at the target location, granting the first ally to walk through it 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec. Only 3 feathers can be placed at one time.

name: Dispel Magic
description: Dispels Magic on the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.

name: Holy Nova
description: An explosion of holy light around you deals up to 156 Holy damage to enemies and up to 119 healing to allies within 12 yds, reduced if there are more than 5 targets.

name: Holy Word: Sanctify
description: Releases miraculous light at a target location, healing up to 5 allies within 10 yds for 2,244.\n\nCooldown reduced by 6 sec when you cast Prayer of Healing.

name: Holy Word: Serenity
description: Perform a miracle, healing an ally for 8,162.\n\nCooldown reduced by 6 sec when you cast Flash Heal.

name: Prayer of Healing
description: A powerful prayer that heals your target and 4 injured allies within 40 yards for 2,236.

name: Shackle Horror
description: Shackles an aberration or undead enemy for 50 sec, preventing all actions and movement. Damage will cancel the effect. Limit 1.

name: Shadow Word: Death
description: A word of dark binding that inflicts 322 Shadow damage to your target. If your target is not killed by Shadow Word: Death, you take backlash damage equal to 5% of your maximum health.\n\nDamage increased by 150% to targets below 20% health.

name: Dominate Mind
description: Controls a mind up to 1 level above yours for 30 sec while still controlling your own mind. Does not work versus Demonic, Mechanical, or Undead beings or players. This spell shares diminishing returns with other disorienting effects.

name: Mind Control
description: Controls a mind up to 1 level above yours for 30 sec. Does not work versus Demonic, Undead, or Mechanical beings. Shares diminishing returns with other disorienting effects.

name: Spirit of Redemption
description: The Priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 6 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the Priest can cast any healing spell free of cost.

name: Ascension
description: Ascend into the air, keeping you out of harm's way. Lasts 20 sec. Can only be used while in Ashran.

name: Light's Wrath
description: Draws upon the power of Light's Wrath, dealing 665 Radiant damage to the target, increased by 10% per ally affected by your Atonement.

name: Void Torrent
description: Raise your dagger into the sky, channeling a torrent of void energy into the target for 1,146 Shadow damage over 4 sec. Insanity does not drain during this channel.\n\nRequires Voidform.

name: Purify
description: Dispels harmful effects on the target, removing all Magic effects.

name: Purify Disease
description: Removes all Disease effects from a friendly target.

name: Power Word: Shield
description: Shields an ally for 15 sec, absorbing 1,754 damage.

name: Mind Soothe
description: Soothes enemies in the target area, reducing the range at which they will detect you by 10 yards. Only affects Humanoid and Dragonkin targets. Does not cause threat. Lasts 20 sec.

name: Prayer of Mending
description: Places a ward on an ally that heals them for 279 the next time they take damage, and then jumps to another ally within 30 yds. Jumps up to 4 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump.

name: Echo of Light
description: Heals every 2 sec for 4 sec.

name: Flash Heal
description: A fast spell that heals an ally for 2,531.

name: Levitate
description: Levitates a party or raid member for 10 min, floating a few feet above the ground, granting slow fall, and allowing travel over water.

name: Light of T'uure
description: Applies Light of the Naaru to the target, healing for 380 and increasing your healing done to that target by 25% for 10 sec.

name: Mass Resurrection
description: Brings all dead party members back to life with 35% health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Mind Vision
description: Allows the caster to see through the target's eyes for 1 min. Will not work if the target is in another instance or on another continent.

name: Power Word: Fortitude
description: Infuses the target with vitality, increasing their Stamina by 5% for 1 hour.\n\nIf the target is in your party or raid, all party and raid members will be affected.

name: Resurrection
description: Brings a dead ally back to life with 35% health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Shadow Word: Pain
description: A word of darkness that causes 63 Shadow damage instantly, and an additional 424 Shadow damage over 16 sec.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Smite
description: Smites an enemy for 370 Holy damage.

name: Greater Heal
description: An exceptional spell that heals an ally for 40% of their maximum health, ignoring healing reduction effects.

name: Absolute Faith
description: Leap of Faith also pulls the spirit of the 3 furthest allies within 40 yards and shields you and the affected allies for 2,851.

name: Improved Mass Dispel
description: Reduces the cooldown of Mass Dispel by 60 sec.

name: Phase Shift
description: Step into the shadows when you cast Fade, avoiding all attacks and spells for 1 sec.\n\nInterrupt effects are not affected by Phase Shift.

name: Psychic Shroud
description: When your Psychic Scream affects 1 or more players, the next crowd control effect against you is prevented. Lasts 6 sec.

name: Purification
description: Purify now has a maximum of 2 charges.\n\nRemoving harmful effects with Purify grants your target an absorption shield equal to 5% of their maximum health. Lasts 8 sec.

name: Sanctified Ground
description: Holy Word: Sanctify blesses the ground with divine light, causing all allies who stand within to be immune to all silence and interrupt effects. Lasts for 5 sec.

name: Spirit of the Redeemer
description: Your Spirit of Redemption is now an active ability with a 2 minute cooldown, but the duration is reduced by 9 sec and you will no longer enter Spirit of Redemption upon dying.

name: Afterlife
description: Increases the duration of Spirit of Redemption by 50% and the range of its spells by 50%.

name: Angel's Mercy
description: Reduces the cooldown of Desperate Prayer by 20 sec.

name: Angelic Bulwark
description: When an attack brings you below 30% health, you gain an absorption shield equal to 25% of your maximum health for 20 sec. Cannot occur more than once every 90 sec.

name: Angelic Touch
description: Your healing spells critically strike for 220% of healing done instead of the usual 200%.

name: Assured Safety
description:
Casting Prayer of Mending applies Power Word: Shield to your target.

 Power Word: Shield
Shields an ally for 15 sec, absorbing 1,726 damage.

name: Benediction
description: Prayer of Mending healing has a chance to upgrade your next Flash Heal to Benediction, healing the target for 30% more and causing a Cosmic Ripple.

name: Benevolence
description: Increases the healing of your spells by 3%.

name: Binding Heals
description: 20% of Flash Heal or Shadow Mend healing on other targets also heals you.

name: Body and Soul
description: Power Word: Shield and Leap of Faith increase your target's movement speed by 40% for 3 sec.

name: Burning Vehemence
description: Increases the damage of Holy Fire by 30%.\n\nHoly Fire deals 75% of its initial damage to all nearby enemies within 12 yards of your target. Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.

name: Censure
description: Holy Word: Chastise stuns the target for 4 sec and is not broken by damage.

name: Cosmic Ripple
description: When Holy Word: Serenity or Holy Word: Sanctify finish their cooldown, you emit a burst of light that heals up to 5 injured targets within 40 yards for 459.

name: Cosmic Wave
description: Increases Cosmic Ripple healing by 15%.

name: Crisis Management
description: Increases the critical strike chance of Flash Heal and Prayer of Healing by 15%.

name: Dark Enlightenment
description: Increases your haste by 3%.

name: Desperate Measures
description: Desperate Prayer lasts an additional 10 sec.\n\nAngelic Bulwark's absorption effect is increased by 15% of your maximum health.

name: Desperate Times
description: Increases healing by 10% on friendly targets at or below 50% health.

name: Dispersing Light
description: 5% of healing done with Flash Heal is replicated to 4 injured allies within 40 yards.

name: Divine Feathers
description: Your Angelic Feathers increase movement speed by an additional 10%.\n\nWhen an ally walks through your Angelic Feather, you are also granted 100% of its effect.

name: Divine Halo
description: Halo now centers around you and returns to you after it reaches its maximum distance, healing allies and damaging enemies each time it passes through them.

name: Divine Image
description: Your Holy Words summon an image of a Naaru at your side. For 9 sec, whenever you cast a healing or damaging spell, the Naaru will cast a similar spell.\n\nIf an image has already been summoned, that image is empowered instead.

name: Divine Service
description: Prayer of Mending heals 4% more for each bounce remaining.

name: Divinity
description: Your healing is increased by 10% while Apotheosis is active.\n\nCasting Apotheosis causes your next 3 Prayer of Healing casts to be instant and heal for 25% more.

name: Efficient Prayers
description: Reduces the mana cost of Prayer of Healing by 15%.

name: Empowered Surges
description: Your spells affected by Surge of Light heal for 5% more while Surge of Light is active.

name: Empyreal Blaze
description: Holy Word: Chastise causes your next 2 casts of Holy Fire to be instant, cost no mana, and incur no cooldown.\n\nRefreshing Holy Fire on a target now extends its duration by 7 sec.

name: Energy Compression
description: Halo damage and healing is increased by 30%.

name: Energy Conservation
description: Power Surge lasts an additional 5 sec.

name: Energy Cycle
description: Casting Mind Flay: Insanity has a 100% chance to conjure Shadowy Apparitions.

name: Enlightenment
description: You regenerate mana 10% faster.

name: Epiphany
description: Your Holy Words have a 25% chance to cause your next cast of Prayer of Mending to ignore its cooldown.

name: Eternal Sanctity
description: Increases the duration of Apotheosis by 12 sec.

name: Everlasting Light
description: Surge of Light occurs up to 50% more often based on your missing mana.

name: False Autonomy
description: Increases the duration of Mind Control and Dominate Mind against enemy creatures by 15 sec.

name: Focused Outburst
description: Void Volley deals 5% increased damage and Shadow Word: Madness casts during Voidform unleash a Void Volley at your target at 25% effectiveness.

name: Focused Power
description: Increases the damage of your spells by 3%.

name: Foreseen Circumstances
description: Guardian Spirit lasts an additional 2 sec.

name: Gales of Song
description: While channeling Divine Hymn, place 2 stacks of Prayer of Mending on up to 3 allies within its range every 0.9 sec.

name: Guardian Angel
description: When Guardian Spirit saves the target from death, it does not expire.\n\nWhen Guardian Spirit expires without saving the target from death, reduce its remaining cooldown to 60 seconds.

name: Guiding Light
description: Prayer of Mending gains an additional charge.

name: Healing Focus
description: Reduces the mana cost of Flash Heal by 15%.

name: Heightened Alteration
description: Increases the duration of Dispersion by 2 sec.

name: Holy Celerity
description: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Words by 15 sec.

name: Improved Fade
description: Reduces the cooldown of Fade by 5 sec.

name: Improved Flash Heal
description: Increases healing done by Flash Heal and Shadow Mend by 15%.

name: Improved Purify
description: Purify additionally removes all Disease effects.

name: Incessant Screams
description: Psychic Scream creates an image of you at your location. After 4 sec, the image will let out a Psychic Scream.

name: Inspiration
description: Reduces your target's physical damage taken by 5% for 15 sec after a critical heal with Flash Heal, Shadow Mend, or Penance.

name: Lasting Words
description:
Holy Word: Serenity applies 12 sec of Renew to its target.

Holy Word: Sanctify applies 6 sec of Renew to allies it heals.

 Renew
Fill the target with faith in the light, healing for 1,223 over 12 sec.

name: Light in the Darkness
description: Increases the healing done by Holy Word: Serenity and Holy Word: Sanctify by 30%.\n\nIncreases the radius of Holy Word: Sanctify by 30%.

name: Light of the Naaru
description: The cooldowns of your Holy Words are reduced by an additional 10% when you cast the relevant spells.

name: Light's Inspiration
description: Increases the maximum health gained from Desperate Prayer by 10%.

name: Light's Resurgence
description:
Your Prayer of Mending has a 12% chance to leave a Renew on each target it heals.

 Renew
Fill the target with faith in the light, healing for 1,528 over 15 sec.

name: Lightburst
description: Increases the damage of Holy Nova by 400%, its healing by 500%, and its cooldown by 30 sec.

name: Lightweaver
description: Flash Heal reduces the cast time of your next Prayer of Healing within 20 sec by 30% and increases its healing done by 18%.\n\nCan accumulate up to 4 charges.

name: Manifested Power
description:
Creating a Halo grants Surge of Light.

 Surge of Light
Your healing spells and Smite have a 8% chance to make your next Flash Heal or Shadow Mend instant and cost 50% less mana. Stacks to 2.

name: Mental Agility
description: Reduces the mana cost of Purify and Mass Dispel by 50% and Dispel Magic by 10%.

name: Mindpierce
description: Increases the damage of Smite by 15%.

name: Miracle Worker
description: Holy Word: Serenity and Holy Word: Sanctify gain an additional charge.

name: Move with Grace
description: Reduces the cooldown of Leap of Faith by 30 sec.

name: Painful Invocation
description: Increases the damage of Shadow Word: Pain by 10%.

name: Perfected Form
description: Your damage dealt is increased by 5% while Voidform is active.

name: Petrifying Scream
description: Psychic Scream causes enemies to tremble in place instead of fleeing in fear.

name: Phantasm
description: Activating Fade removes all snare effects.

name: Phantom Reach
description: Increases the range of most spells by 15%.

name: Piety
description: 20% of overhealing done is redistributed to up to 4 nearby injured allies.

name: Power Surge
description: Casting Halo also causes you to create a Halo around you at 100% effectiveness every 5 sec for 10 sec.

name: Prayerful Litany
description: The primary target of Prayer of Healing is healed for 125% more.

name: Prayers of the Virtuous
description: Prayer of Mending jumps 2 additional times.

name: Preemptive Care
description: Increases the duration of your Renew by 40%.

name: Preventive Measures
description: Increases the healing done by Prayer of Mending by 15%.\n\nAll damage dealt by Smite, Holy Fire and Holy Nova increased by 40%.

name: Prismatic Echoes
description: Increases the healing done by your Mastery: Echo of Light by 5% and your Renew by 13%.

name: Prompt Prognosis
description: Casting Prayer of Mending heals your target for 4,643.

name: Prophet's Insight
description: Atonement healing from Holy spells is increased by 15%.

name: Prophet's Will
description: Your Flash Heal, Shadow Mend, and Power Word: Shield are 30% more effective when cast on yourself.

name: Protective Light
description: Casting Flash Heal or Shadow Mend on yourself reduces all damage you take by 10% for 10 sec.

name: Psychic Voice
description: Reduces the cooldown of Psychic Scream by 10 sec.

name: Radiant Plea
description: Increases Prayer of Mending healing by 15%.

name: Realized Potential
description: Shadow Word: Death damage increased by 25% and its cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.

name: Renewed Faith
description: Your healing on allies with your Renew is increased by 10%.

name: Resonant Energy
description: Creating a Halo increases your healing done by 2% for 10 sec, stacking up to 4 times.

name: Restitution
description: After Spirit of Redemption expires, you will revive at up to 100% health, based on your healing done during Spirit of Redemption. After reviving, you cannot benefit from Spirit of Redemption for 10 min.

name: Sanguine Teachings
description: Increases your Leech by 2%.

name: Save the Day
description: For 6 sec after casting Leap of Faith you may cast it a second time for free, ignoring its cooldown.

name: Say Your Prayers
description: Prayer of Mending has a 15% chance to not consume a charge when it jumps to a new target.

name: Seraphic Crescendo
description: Reduces the cooldown of Divine Hymn by 60 sec.

name: Sheer Terror
description: Increases the amount of damage required to break your Psychic Scream by 25%.

name: Shock Pulse
description: Halo damage reduces enemy movement speed by 5% for 5 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

name: Spectral Illusion
description: Fade creates an illusion of you for 4 sec, tricking enemies to attack it instead.

name: Spell Warding
description: Reduces all magic damage taken by 3%.

name: Spiritual Guidance
description: Increases your Intellect by 3%.

name: Spiritwell
description: Increases Shadowy Apparition damage by 10%.

name: Strength of Resolve
description: Increases your Stamina by 6%.

name: Surge of Light
description: Your healing spells and Smite have a 8% chance to make your next Flash Heal or Shadow Mend instant and cost 50% less mana. Stacks to 2.

name: Sustained Potency
description: Creating a Halo extends the duration of Voidform by 1 sec. If Voidform is not active, up to 6 seconds is stored.\n\nWhile out of combat or affected by a loss of control effect, the duration of Voidform is paused for up to 20 sec.

name: Tithe Evasion
description: Shadow Word: Death deals 50% less damage to you.

name: Trail of Light
description: 25% of healing done by Flash Heal is replicated to the previous target you healed with those spells.

name: Translucent Image
description: Fade reduces damage you take by 10%.

name: Twin Disciplines
description: Increases the damage and healing of your Holy and Shadow spells by 2%.

name: Twins of the Sun Priestess
description: Power Infusion also grants you its effect at 100% value when used on an ally. \n\nIf no ally is targeted, it will grant its effect at 100% value to a nearby ally, preferring damage dealers.

name: Twinsight
description: 3 additional Penance bolts are fired at an enemy within 40 yards when healing an ally with Penance, or fired at an ally within 40 yards when damaging an enemy with Penance.

name: Twist of Fate
description: After damaging or healing a target below 35% health, gain 5% increased damage and healing for 8 sec.

name: Ultimate Serenity
description: Increases the healing done by Holy Word: Serenity by 10% and causes it to heal 4 nearby injured allies within 40 yards for 15% of its healing done.\n\nTalents that affect Holy Word: Sanctify instead affect Holy Word: Serenity.

name: Unfolding Vision
description: When Power Word: Shield or Void Shield expires with absorption remaining, it jumps to a nearby injured ally instead. Can only happen once per shield.

name: Unwavering Will
description: While above 75% health, the cast time of your Flash Heal, Shadow Mend, and Smite are reduced by 5%.

name: Uplifting Words
description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Word: Serenity and Holy Word: Sanctify by 10%.

name: Voice of Harmony
description: Prayer of Mending reduces the cooldown of Holy Word: Serenity by 4 sec.\n\nHoly Fire reduces the cooldown of Holy Word: Chastise by 4 sec.

name: Void Tendrils
description: Call shadowy tendrils to constrict enemies when Psychic Scream ends, rooting them in place for 4 sec.

name: Waste No Time
description: Reduces the cooldown of Prayer of Mending by 1.5 sec.

name: Word of Supremacy
description: Power Word: Fortitude grants you an additional 5% stamina.

name: Words of the Wise
description: Flash Heal, Shadow Mend, Plea, and Power Word: Radiance healing increased by 15%.

name: Focused Will
description: Melee attacks against you cause you to gain Focused Will, reducing damage you take by 15% for 8 sec, stacking up to 1 times.

name: Mastery: Echo of Light
description: Your direct healing spells heal for an additional 18.6% over 4 sec.\n\nIncreases the healing of Renew by 18.6%.

name: Renewed Vigor
description: Each target affected by your Renew increases the critical strike chance of your spells and abilities by $1306118s1%, up to ${$1306118s1*$1306118u}%.
